daily.title: The one-minute reset
daily.text: A short, focused typing session can be a useful reset between larger tasks. Breathe out, relax your shoulders, and give the next character your full attention.

daily.title: Make room for accuracy
daily.text: Speed becomes more useful when it is supported by control. Let your hands follow the words, notice the small corrections, and leave the session with one clear lesson.

daily.title: A repeatable rhythm
daily.text: The most valuable practice is easy to return to. Choose a comfortable pace, keep your eyes on the line, and build a rhythm that can travel with you into tomorrow.

daily.title: Quiet progress
daily.text: Progress is often quieter than a personal record. A cleaner correction, a softer wrist, or one fewer hesitation can be enough evidence that your practice is working.

daily.title: Focus on the next key
daily.text: You do not need to predict the whole passage. Read ahead just enough to prepare, then focus on the next key with calm and steady intent.
